title: Extinction

{{Quest infobox | name = Extinction | map = [[Image:Extinction map.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Nightfall | region = Vabbi | type = Secondary | given by = [[Lieutenant Murunda]] | given at = [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] | preceded by = [[Guard Rescue]]
[[Dasha Vestibule]] or [[Dzagonur Bastion]] }} In the aftermath of the assault on the Citadel, the heket are gathering strength under a new leader. Lieutenant Murunda needs the party to seek out and quell the heket forces, and kill their leader. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Explore the area outside the [[Citadel of Dzagon|Citadel]] and kill any remaining [[heket]]. [6...0] of 6 heket groups remain. * Locate the [[Brokk Ripsnort|heket leader]]. * Defeat the heket leader and his comrades. * See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward. ===Reward=== * 2,000 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * [[Trade Contract]] ===Environmental changes=== * [[Bull Trainer Giant]]s, [[Hunting Minotaur]]s, and [[Kunan the Loudmouth]] will [[spawn]] in [[Wilderness of Bahdza]] after this quest is completed. * The Hekets in Wilderness of Bahdza ([[Beast Sworn Heket]]s, [[Blood Cowl Heket]]s, [[Blue Tongue Heket]]s, [[Brokk Ripsnort]], and [[Stoneaxe Heket]]s) will no longer spawn after this quest is completed. ==Walkthrough== Head out from Dzagonur Bastion and follow your quest pointer to each of the 6 heket groups in turn, that are all clustered in the north-east corner of the Wilderness of Bahdza. After killing the 6 heket groups, make your way to the heket leader, [[Brokk Ripsnort]], who is accompanied by one final heket group. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Lieutenant Murunda''' :''"One of the scouts I sent to determine how hard the Citadel had been hit reported seeing some heket still congregating in packs to the east. That's hunting behavior for them, and a second scout confirmed my fear. A new heket alpha leader is attempting to organize what remains of those beasts for an assault while we are still damaged. If this leader succeeds, I don't think we'll be able to withstand the attack, what with the shape we're in. I must ask your aid, though it wounds my pride. Enter the '''Wilderness of Bahdza'''. Hunt down and slay the '''heket leader'''. That should put a stop to them, at least until the next alpha decides to go for broke."'' {{offer dialog |accept = He's the alpha, I'm the omega. |decline = I'll be back. |ask = The '''heket leader''' is somewhere in the '''Wilderness of Bahdza''' gathering inhuman allies for a new assault. Find and kill this heket. }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''Lieutenant Murunda''' :''"Excellent. With that alpha gone, I suspect the heket will think twice about attacking any time soon. We should be safe here for the foreseeable future."'' ==Trivia== * The decline dialogue is probably a reference to [[W:Arnold Schwarzenegger|Arnold Schwarzenegger]]'s famous line in ''[[W: The Terminator| The Terminator]]''.
